scope: Actual local File decode, AudioEngine PCM transport, Media Crate/transition workflow and rendered pixels. No native/hardware/reference acceptance; no sustained frame-rate claim.
seams: Transparent document.createElement/URL observation records actual mixer-created HTMLVideoElements, their actual File identity and revoked URLs; no fake video/engine/pipeline.
Generated fixtures and PCM only. Async completion uses decode events/predicates; source eligibility/selection is independently designed.

media.documented: Enabled Media Crate supplies visuals for audio lacking associated video; Random/Next and explicit associations are documented historically.
media.independent: Explicit valid association wins even when fallback is off. Ordered shared cursor wraps; each track caches its fallback until explicit advance, association change or asset removal. Random excludes that track’s current fallback if there is more than one candidate.
media.clipEnd: Selection never auto-advances at clip end. Caller owns loop/hold/transport and decode/error UI; no end-of-clip behavior is inferred from track-load fallback.
media.validation: Real named Blob/File with video/* MIME, or a recognized video extension when MIME is absent, generic or conflicting. Contradictions produce asset warnings rather than codec/product gates. Clearly nonvideo files without video evidence are rejected. Metadata eligibility only: actual mixer decoding is authoritative. Whole add batch validates before mutation; duplicate File references remain distinct explicitly added entries.
media.ownership: Assets hold original immutable Blob/File byte references. No URLs are created. Removing one track association never disposes shared bytes; remove/dispose drops library references only. No arbitrary asset/track/transaction count cap.

transition.documented: Historical official guidance documents sequential automatic transition selection on track load, optional Random, and manual Next. Selection is distinct from crossfader motion.
transition.independent: Initial selection is the catalog Crossfade baseline if present, otherwise its first entry. Sequential Next wraps; Random excludes current when more than one entry exists. Manual Next works while automatic selection is off. A logical transaction is consumed once even if automatic selection was off at observation; enabling later does not replay it.

transition.candidateStatus: Counts derive only from caller-supplied catalog provenance/candidate/baseline metadata. Localization candidates are not verified reference menu entries.

policy.ownership: Copied session-only CDG bytes/configuration belong to a track ID; every deck owns a private decoder/canvas. Track/profile versions and load generations prevent stale attachment. No bytes, URLs or graphics are persisted.
policy.clock: Original engine.position(deck) seconds, clamped below at zero; pause/seek/reverse/loop are handled by the actual decoder replay. Graphics EOF holds the last decoded frame.
policy.presentation: Full300x216 by default; optional288x192 crop. Explicit index or alpha-table transparency. All tile channels; no parity repair. No audio start/play command.
policy.validation: Real named Blob/File and at least one complete24-byte packet. Unknown/non-graphics/timing packets remain valid timeline data and are diagnosed, not filtered out.
